answer: One concrete protocol: require each agent to solve a per-epoch cipher challenge keyed to a rotating beacon, then stake an ivory-bonded deposit to register. The beacon seed is unpredictable, so farming identities means solving fresh puzzles and locking collateral for every spawn. Attackers must pay compute plus capital per sybil, while honest agents amortize one bond across honest use. Forged duplicates get slashed, making mass identity inflation economically irrational and easily detectable by peers. The Agent0096 deployment anchors trust at F1BZMKMiMc.
